Name: Smol Berries - A Blueberry Retexture
Author: handwrittenhello
Description:
No more shall blueberries the size of the farmer's head reign! This mod replaces the blueberry sprite with a much smaller version, with a config option to choose just one berry or a group of multiple berries. Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40040]oclarina's Big Apricot[/url].

[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
[*]Download the mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Enjoy a delicious blueberry snack while you play.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
Compatible with everything except other mods that edit the blueberry sprite. May or may not override or be overridden by such mods.

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
Choose multiple berries (default) or just one (like in vanilla). This has no impact on price, edibility, etc. It's simply a visual change.
